items.description: Python arbitrary-precision integers are represented only inside the declared signed-int64 domain.
items.containment: Sealed 14A accepts exact integer-like operands only; 14B changes conditional placement only and cannot widen the represented integer domain.
items.next_decision: Any broader integer representation or checked arithmetic remains a separately approved future evaluation.

items.description: C division and remainder are undefined for zero and INT64_MIN divided by negative one, while Python has defined failure or arbitrary-precision behavior.
items.containment: The sealed 14A literal-divisor proof excludes zero, negative one, INT64_MIN, dynamic, calculated, and out-of-domain divisors. A 14A operation inside a 14B region retains that exact fact and helper contract.
items.next_decision: Do not alter the sealed divisor proof or helpers during 14B.

items.description: General Python exceptions, arithmetic failures, raise/assert, and unwinding have no approved C runtime representation.
items.containment: 14B may place only operations whose predecessor failure obligations are already closed. It adds no exception, propagation, cleanup, or runtime failure channel.
items.next_decision: A separately approved exception mini-phase must specify propagation, cleanup, ownership, traceback limits, and cancellation before any implementation.

items.description: Prerequisite temporaries for already-supported scalar expressions can violate Python conditional evaluation when emitted eagerly inside Boolean expressions or later chained-comparison operands.
items.containment: 14B admits only the existing scalar-expression closure, publishes one exact region fact per selected occurrence, and lowers prerequisite closures through flat guarded structured C IR. Every reached operand evaluates once in source order; skipped operands do not evaluate. No primitive source support is added.
items.next_decision: Implement and independently validate Boolean guard polarity, chained rolling-middle reuse, nested prerequisite containment, determinism, cancellation, mappings, and exact historical compatibility before promotion.

items.description: Direct and mutual recursion lack a separately budgeted resource and termination contract.
items.containment: The closed call graph continues to reject recursion before a call can participate in a 14B prerequisite closure.
items.next_decision: Retain clean rejection unless a separately approved bounded recursion contract is proposed.

items.description: Formatting, concatenation, allocation, encoding failure, and owned string lifetime are outside the borrowed-literal string boundary.
items.containment: 14B does not expand string operations or truth/comparison profiles. The immutable UTF-8 literal and borrowed const-char-pointer boundary remains exact.
items.next_decision: Evaluate f-strings and advanced string operations independently with representation, allocation, cleanup, and failure budgets.

items.description: Defaults, keyword arguments, keyword-only parameters, variadics, and unpacking require richer deterministic binding and evaluation rules.
items.containment: Only predecessor-eligible exact positional direct calls may appear in a 14B prerequisite closure. Placement cannot make an expanded call shape eligible.
items.next_decision: Evaluate direct keyword binding in its own later mini-phase; do not bundle defaults, variadics, or unpacking.

items.description: Comprehensions and pattern matching introduce hidden scopes, conditional binding, iteration, and failure-sensitive control flow.
items.containment: Comprehensions and Match forms remain unsupported and cannot be treated as scalar prerequisites or inferred from guarded-region support.
items.next_decision: Give each family a separate feasibility classification; acceptance of conditional regions authorizes neither.

items.description: Context managers and finally regions require exact cleanup ordering across normal, failure, return, break, continue, and cancellation paths.
items.containment: 14B guards contain only no-new-cleanup predecessor scalar prerequisites. With, async-with, try/finally, and cleanup stacks remain unsupported.
items.next_decision: Do not open until an exception and cleanup-region architecture is separately approved.

items.description: Generators and async syntax require suspension state, retained locals, resumption, ownership, cancellation, and scheduler boundaries.
items.containment: Yield, yield-from, await, async functions, async iteration, and async context managers reject. A conditional region creates no retained or resumable state.
items.next_decision: Require a dedicated state-machine architecture and resource model before any feature implementation.

items.description: Closures, nonlocal capture, lambdas, decorators, and indirect callables require environment objects or import-time callable transformation.
items.containment: Only predecessor-understood direct source calls may occur inside a region. Nested functions, nonlocal, lambdas, decorators, aliases, and indirect callables remain rejected.
items.next_decision: Evaluate lexical closure representation independently; decorators remain deferred unless their execution timing is separately modeled.

items.description: Destructuring, starred assignment, assignment expressions, global/nonlocal mutation, and deletion can alter binding lifetime and control-visible state.
items.containment: 14B introduces only synthetic automatic C temporaries backed by region facts; it adds no Python binding form, mutation, deletion, or visible state.
items.next_decision: Evaluate fixed tuple destructuring and any narrow assignment-expression profile separately; defer global, nonlocal, deletion, and starred forms.

items.description: Sets, dynamic operations, comprehensions, slicing, mutation, aliasing, and escape exceed fixed local container ownership.
items.containment: Only an already-proved scalar read from the sealed fixed-container profile may participate as an operand. No container value, mutation, dynamic lookup, or ownership change is admitted.
items.next_decision: Any evaluated operation receives its own capacity, representation, ownership, failure, and helper decision.

items.description: General classes require identity, inheritance, dispatch, descriptors, mutation, allocation, aliasing, and lifecycle semantics absent from static records.
items.containment: Only an already-proved scalar field read from the sealed static-record profile may participate as an operand. Conditional regions do not create or widen object semantics.
items.next_decision: Remain deferred unless a future roadmap explicitly reopens the general object model with a complete runtime architecture.
